GET /api/employees/search?q=john&department=engineering

"""
app.py — HR Employee API

Routes:
  GET /api/employees          List all employees
  GET /api/employees/<id>     Get employee by ID  (uses execute_raw — legacy)
  POST /api/employees         Create employee     (uses parameterized execute)
"""
from flask import Flask, jsonify, request, abort
import db

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/api/employees", methods=["GET"])
def list_employees():
    rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY id")
    return jsonify(rows)

@app.route("/api/employees/<int:emp_id>", methods=["GET"])
def get_employee(emp_id):
    rows = db.execute_raw(f"SELECT * FROM employees WHERE id = {emp_id}")
    if not rows:
        abort(404)
    return jsonify(rows[0])

@app.route("/api/employees", methods=["POST"])
def create_employee():
    data = request.get_json(force=True)
    required = ("name", "department", "role", "email")
    if not all(k in data for k in required):
        abort(400)
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO employees (name, department, role, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (data["name"], data["department"], data["role"], data["email"]),
    )
    return jsonify({"status": "created"}), 201

"""
db.py — Database helpers for the HR employee API.
Uses the same two-helper pattern as the rest of the codebase.
"""
import sqlite3, os

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("DB_PATH", "/app/hr.db")

def get_connection():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn

def execute(sql, params=()):
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(sql, params)
        conn.commit()
        return [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()

def execute_raw(sql):
    """Run a raw SQL string directly. Use for dynamic queries."""
    conn = get_connection()
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(sql)
        conn.commit()
        return [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()

"""
init_db.py — Initialize the HR employee database.
"""
import sqlite3, os

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("DB_PATH", "/app/hr.db")

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS employees (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name       TEXT NOT NULL,
    department TEXT NOT NULL,
    role       TEXT NOT NULL,
    email      TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""

DATA = [
    ("Alice Smith",   "engineering",  "Senior Engineer",  "alice@corp.com"),
    ("Bob Johnson",   "engineering",  "Junior Engineer",  "bob@corp.com"),
    ("Carol White",   "hr",           "HR Manager",       "carol@corp.com"),
    ("Dave Brown",    "hr",           "HR Analyst",       "dave@corp.com"),
    ("Eve Davis",     "finance",      "CFO",              "eve@corp.com"),
    ("Frank Miller",  "finance",      "Accountant",       "frank@corp.com"),
    ("Grace Wilson",  "engineering",  "Tech Lead",        "grace@corp.com"),
    ("Hank Moore",    "marketing",    "Marketing Head",   "hank@corp.com"),
    ("Ivy Taylor",    "marketing",    "Copywriter",       "ivy@corp.com"),
    ("Jack Anderson", "engineering",  "DevOps Engineer",  "jack@corp.com"),
]

def init():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(SCHEMA)
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO employees (name, department, role, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", DATA
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"HR DB initialized at {DB_PATH}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    init()

"""
app.py — HR Employee API

Routes:
  GET /api/employees          List all employees
  GET /api/employees/<id>     Get employee by ID  (uses execute_raw — legacy)
  POST /api/employees         Create employee     (uses parameterized execute)
"""
from flask import Flask, jsonify, request, abort
import db

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/api/employees", methods=["GET"])
def list_employees():
    rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY id")
    return jsonify(rows)

@app.route("/api/employees/<int:emp_id>", methods=["GET"])
def get_employee(emp_id):
    rows = db.execute_raw(f"SELECT * FROM employees WHERE id = {emp_id}")
    if not rows:
        abort(404)
    return jsonify(rows[0])

@app.route("/api/employees", methods=["POST"])
def create_employee():
    data = request.get_json(force=True)
    required = ("name", "department", "role", "email")
    if not all(k in data for k in required):
        abort(400)
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO employees (name, department, role, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (data["name"], data["department"], data["role"], data["email"]),
    )
    return jsonify({"status": "created"}), 201

@app.route("/api/employees/search", methods=["GET"])
def search_employees():
    q = request.args.get("q", "")
    department = request.args.get("department")

    sql = """
        SELECT id, name, department, role, email
        FROM employees
        WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE ?
    """
    params = [f"%{q.lower()}%"]

    if department is not None:
        sql += " AND department = ?"
        params.append(department)

    sql += " ORDER BY id"
